## 💡 Challenge Suggestion

### Basic Info

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Proposed Category** | *(e.g., cryptography, binary_exploitation, web_exploitation)* |
| **Proposed Difficulty** | *(🟢 Easy / 🟡 Medium / 🔴 Hard / ⚫ Insane)* |
| **Proposed Points** | *(e.g., 500)* |

---

### Challenge Title

> A thematic, espionage-themed name for the challenge.  
> Example: *"The Phantom Key"*, *"Dead Signal"*

---

### Vulnerability / Concept

> What cybersecurity concept does this challenge teach?  
> Example: *RSA Wiener's Attack*, *Heap Use-After-Free*, *SSRF via DNS rebinding*

---

### Story / Narrative

> Write a brief in-universe story for the challenge (fits the OBV espionage theme).

*"Agent. We've intercepted a..."*

---

### Technical Description

> How would the challenge work? What files would be provided? What would the player need to do?

---

### Why Should We Include This?

> What makes this challenge interesting, educational, or unique?

---

### References / Resources

> Any relevant CTF write-ups, papers, or tools that inspired this challenge?

- [ ] I have checked that this challenge concept does not already exist in the repo
- [ ] I am willing to help build/test this challenge if accepted
